text_block_list.text:
Right before the race, when I headed to 
the waiting room... Mayano Top Gun seemed 
to be doing mental imagery training.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And then when the girl ahead of me comes 
up, I'll go whoosh and break away...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawa, whoa! I didn't notice at all! 
Why, whyyy!?
choice_data_list: Looks like I got carried away.
Looks like I got carried away, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, yeah! Maya's heart has been 
pounding non-stop since earlier.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Buuut... next up, is Trainer-chan's turn!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya's running is gonna make you fall head 
over heels♪
